I built [gemnotes](https://github.com/dylanpieper/gemnotes) for my wife, Julia ❤️, so she could track her hours toward clinical licensure. The process is arduous: therapists have to log thousands of hours across individual and relational sessions, supervision, and administrative work before they can practice independently. Every therapist signs in with their Google account and gets a private dashboard.

![](/media/gemnotes-dash.png){fig-alt="gemnotes dashboard showing licensure hour tracking" fig-align="center" width="700"}

If you're a therapist tracking hours toward licensure, you can use the app yourself at [gemnotes](https://dylanpieper-gemnotes.share.connect.posit.cloud/). This is the most important app I've built, because it's for the most important person in my life. Building my wife tools is one of my love languages. Questions or feedback are welcome at [dylanpieper\@gmail.com](mailto:dylanpieper@gmail.com).
